diff-upstream.//: Print the complete unified diff of the vendored copy against its pinned upstream commit: every vendored change, generated from the tree, never hand-maintained. stdout is a patch (`git apply`-able from the repo root); the file count goes to stderr. Save with: pnpm nx run site-v5:diff-upstream > vendored.patch

vendored-log.//: List every commit that has changed quartz-v5/quartz since the last sync, with the tickets each cites, and flag any that cite none. Uncommitted edits are listed too. Informational: the tracker for ADR-0001's one-ticket-per-vendored-change rule.

diff-latest.//: Informational: what an upgrade to the tip of the tracked branch would pull in.

sync.//: Re-vendor at a new upstream ref. Refuses while the copy carries vendored changes, since syncing replaces the tree: save them with diff-upstream first, then run upstream.mjs sync <ref> --force and re-apply. Usage: nx run site-v5:sync --args="--ref=<commit|branch>"

install.//: Install the vendored copy's own dependencies. Upstream uses npm, and its versions conflict with the v4 tree at the repo root, so this is deliberately isolated from the root pnpm install.

prebuild.//: Prepare the vendored copy to build the real site: symlink the tracked quartz-v5/quartz.config.yaml into it, link host node_modules beside local plugins, and build every local plugin the site config enables. See VENDORED.md.

build.//: Build the real site: content/public, with the tracked config, into quartz-v5/quartz/public, then finish it with utils/postbuild.mjs: the site's own root-level files (robots.txt, BingSiteAuth.xml, the IndexNow key file) and the site's icon over stock's (static/icon.png, favicon.ico). Extra flags go to `quartz build`, e.g. --concurrency=4.

serve.//: Build the real site and serve it with Quartz's dev server, rebuilding on content changes. Mixed-case redirects are only emitted on a case-sensitive filesystem, so a macOS serve shows none. The output, quartz-v5/.serve-public, is outside the vendored copy on purpose: serve's source watcher watches every .ts and .tsx under it, and would take the vault's widget sources, which the build copies into its output, for Quartz's own and restart the whole build over and over (cgc-mdx's watch spec).

_serve-static.//: Helper: serve the real site's build, quartz-v5/quartz/public, on port 8080 for the Lighthouse targets. Ported from v4's `site` project (FORK-LEDGER, #42: keep).

eval.//: Lighthouse audit of the built site's home page, served by _serve-static, then its actionable insights (utils/lighthouse).

eval:live.//: Lighthouse audit of the live site, then its actionable insights (utils/lighthouse).

eval:multi.//: Lighthouse CI over the first public pages of the built site's sitemap, served by _serve-static, then the aggregated insights. generate-urls-from-sitemap.mjs writes the lighthouserc.cjs autorun reads.

clean.//: Remove build output and caches from the vendored copy.
